title: SUKURA GRAPE + ICE SPRING – MOOODAN DUAL FLAVOUR – 7000 PUFFS
description:
Introducing the MOODAN 7000 Dual Flavour Vape – the latest innovation in the vaping market, offering an impressive 7000 puffs. With two distinct flavours, each delivering up to 3500 puffs, the rotating head design allows you to easily switch between flavours with a simple twist.

Key Features:

- Dual flavours with 7,000+ puffs per flavour

- Rotating head for effortless flavour switching

- Puffs Up to 7000;

- E-liquid 7+7 ml

- Coil Mesh coil

- Resistance 1.2 ohm

- Battery 550 mAh rechargeable

- Charging Port Type-C

- Size 42*97*22mm

- Net Weight 77g

Shipping & delivery:

– Available to ship Ausralia Wide.

– Shipping time is within 24 hours after order.

– All orders are shipped vith AUSPOST Express.

– When order is packed, we’ll send you a tracking number.

– Delivery will arrive within 2-5 business days depending on location within Australia.

The IGET Bar is a device for leisure vaping, 3500 puff made of light 304 Stainless Steel, providing comfortable hand feeling. With amazing flavours and a large capacity, the IGET Bar will be there for whenever you need it.

PACKAGE INCLUDES:

Chosen flavours of MOOODAN Vape.
